blurb: Captain Sean offers sport fishing charters with a focus on a one-on-one fishing experience. Trips include all tackle and bait, fish cleaning, and optional vacuum packing for an extra fee. Various seasonal and year-round fishing trips are available including shark, sturgeon, salmon, striped bass, and halibut.
